reply_text: Queue was heavy this week. I had many first-review assets waiting at once. I flagged multiple naming and resolution issues and some missing compliance text. Rejections took time because I had to explain reasons clearly.

Scripts were mostly clear but two scenes had vague action direction. One monologue did not match the character attitude, so actors needed extra coaching. If we add stronger movement notes before shoot, performance will improve.

Props were late on one day and two actors arrived behind schedule. We also had power interruptions during setup. Last-minute shot changes from remote side caused delays. A clearer call sheet with priority shots would help.
This week was manageable overall. Fewer assets came in, and revision loops were shorter. Only minor compliance fixes were needed.
I need clearer extras direction in crowd scenes. Main character actions were okay, but supporting reactions felt unnatural until we adjusted blocking.
Weather and traffic affected location timing. Some props arrived late again. We still delivered but setup stress was high. Pre-confirmation a day earlier would reduce risk.
